verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list ARM CPU support and an Apple Silicon hardware plugin, so there is a documented path to running on Apple Silicon. That is only a single thin mention, with no detail on Metal acceleration or performance. missing for 10: explicit Metal/GPU acceleration documentation, Apple Silicon install/setup docs, performance benchmarks on Apple Silicon, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: Support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and x86/ARM/PowerPC CPUs. Additionally, diverse hardware plugins such as Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi, IBM Spyre, Huawei Ascend, Rebellions NPU, Apple Silicon, MetaX GPU, and more.
